context: DOC-C §15 migration gate / DOC-E E3 E12
cause: No real DB apply→rollback proof was required by CI/release attestation.
failed_approach: Treat presence of migration.down.sql or a rollback script as equivalent to executed rollback evidence.
recovery: Create real PostgreSQL schema round-trip proof and make result mandatory in runtime attestation/deploy gate.
boundary: Migration rollback is not PASS unless the real migration executes against a database and schema state returns to the pinned pre-migration model.
prevention: migration-proof manifest + real CI service + exact schema diff + required migration_rollback attestation gate.
